title: Amazing vibes
text: Amazing experience - JB was great and such a great host. What an amazing way to explore the beautiful Costa Brava coastline. Highly recommend!
author: kathycW6071UQ

title: Amazing trip!
text: We had a fantastic day. The hike was amazing, snorkeling was great and I loved the kayak tour. The guide was amazing. All in all just a marvelous day at the costa brava. I would book it again if I am back in the area!
author: 796jordyb

title: 10 out of 10!
text:
This is an excellent way to see Costa Brava-Tossa De Mar if you want to explore a wonder just outside of Barcelona in comfort and with a lovely lunch included. 
Our guide Nacho was very knowledgeable, kind, funny and patient with our diverse group which included participants from young adults to older people from different cultures.
author: Lois_W

title: A perfect day!
text: This is a MUST! We had a fantastic time exploring the truly breathtaking areas of Costa Brava and Tossa Del Mar. Nacho is a 11/10 guide, offering great conversation and photography skills. The small group format was perfect; we were able to make friends with others on the tour and truly enjoyed the opportunity to connect through the experience. Worth every penny.
author: ianmL1792SV

title: Coastal Day Trip
text: What a wonderful day! Lovey coastal tour of two beautiful towns with a swim and delicious meal. Tete was an excellent guide. You will surely enjoy this tour.
author: B8945CNmichellej

title: Tossa de Mar +hiking/swimming
text: We had a great experience with Excursions Barcelona for the Tossa +swimming/hiking tour. Tete was an amazing tour guide who was very personable and accommodating for our group. He provided us with a lot of history and cultural perspectives on the region while making the activity fun for everyone in the group. Would highly recommend for anyone looking to visit Tossa Del Mar and incorporate a light hike and some swimming.
author: pahav2021

title: Exquisite scenery!!
text: We spent a marvelous day with Tete taking the Medieval Tossa de Mar & Scenic Costa Brava Coastal Walk! The views were remarkable and the history lessons were fascinating and thoroughly enjoyable! Thank you, Tete, for your friendliness and expert guidance!!
author: lauriesH9555MV

title: Breathtaking views
text: Tete was an amazing tour guide, very friendly and knowledgeable. The coastal views are breathtaking. Lunch was excellent and restaurant was away from touristy spots. I would recommend if you are in Barcelona and would like to see the coastal areas.
author: Lolitadq99

title: Must do
text: Tete was a great guide. He was friendly and gave us so much facts about places we visited. I would recommend this.
author: 889ramana
